notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature without summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Caberetti Charm by paying {R}{G}{W}.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting and Thornbite Staff attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Cabaretti Charm.
Resolve the copy of Cabaretti Charm, creating two 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Citizen, adding {R}.
The Citizen dies, triggering the creature with Dual Casting and Thornbite Staff attached, untapping the creature.
Repeat from step 2.
